claude-code.description: Model ids accepted by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on the Anthropic API (the --model flag / settings). Source: Claude Code model configuration docs plus Anthropic's current and legacy Claude model overview; provider-specific Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry ids are intentionally excluded. Newer models carry a minimum CLI version (Opus 5.5 needs v2.1.280+, Fable 5.1 v2.1.257+, Opus 5 v2.1.219+, Sonnet 5 v2.1.197+, Fable 5 v2.1.170+). Claude Mythos models are excluded because they require invitation-only Project Glasswing access and are not offered in the normal model picker.

codex.description: User-selectable model ids available through OpenAI's Codex CLI via the ChatGPT OAuth path. The CLI fetches its model catalog from chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex, which is separate from the general OpenAI API. Picker metadata comes from codex-rs/models-manager/models.json in the openai/codex repo; visibility "list" models are offered in the picker, while visibility "hide" models may remain available when named explicitly. GPT-6 Astra requires Codex 0.153.0 or newer and is included during its staged rollout across eligible ChatGPT plans; GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna require Codex 0.155.0 or newer. gpt-5.2 was removed from the bundled catalog as retired. Official OpenAI documentation also accepts gpt-5.6 as the generic GPT-5.6 id and documents gpt-5.3-codex-spark, which is served to eligible accounts despite not appearing in models.json. Models requiring separate approval and provisioning, including gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and gpt-daybreak-red-latest, are excluded, as is internal-only codex-auto-review.

antigravity.description: Model ids accepted by Google's Antigravity CLI (command: agy). Supports multi-provider models. Source: antigravity.google official site/docs bundle; only models with catalog pricing/context data are included.

google-flow.description: Model ids represented by Google Flow's web-based AI filmmaking and image-generation client. Includes the Nano Banana image family (legacy, current, Pro, and Lite) and the Veo 3.1 and Gemini Omni Flash video families. Availability varies by region, Google AI subscription tier, and staged rollout; this is not the complete Gemini API or Vertex AI catalog. Source: Google Flow and Gemini API documentation. Imagen models are intentionally excluded because Google has announced their shutdown on 2026-08-17.
